en: Conditioned by a state that is neither wholesome nor defiled-defiling, an unwholesome, defiled-defiling state arises by way of root condition... (Three [combinations] for the unwholesome alone; abbreviated. Three for root... pe ... three for non-disappearance.
Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor undefiled-non-defiling, an indeterminate, undefiled-non-defiling state arises by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. Six for root, six for predominance... pe ... one for result.
Three ... [as above] ... five in the case of non-disappearance.
Conditioned by a state that is neither wholesome nor defiled nor subject to defilement, a state that is wholesome and not defiled nor subject to defilement arises by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. Six in the case of root; six in the case of object ... [as above] ... in the case of repetition.
Three ... [and so on] ... three in the case of resultants ... [and so on] ... six in the case of non-disappearance.
